outputs.rationale: Ranked by closeness to the query's core insight pattern — using a symmetry/commutation condition plus matching local data to force a global structural conclusion — with 11070 (commuting analytic maps ⇒ equality) being the closest structural analogue.

Ranked by proximity to the 'aha' pattern of a seemingly messy double/iterated integral collapsing to an elegant closed form via clever substitution, internal symmetry, or integral-representation trick, regardless of surface topic.

Ranked by the shared latent insight of choosing an extremal canonical set of small integers to optimize a combinatorial objective — most directly mirrored in C(m), zero-sum extremal sets, and the 1–9 magic-square arrangement.

Ranked by latent structural match to the query's core pattern — equivalence classes of combinatorial objects under a symmetry operation (here cyclic block permutation), prioritizing problems involving equivalence relations, cyclic/group action structures, and combinatorial enumeration of orbits.

Ranked by shared 'eureka' of representing an integrand/sum via an integral or series representation then interchanging operations (Fubini, sum-integral swap, differentiation under integral) to unlock a closed-form evaluation yielding π.

Ranked by shared core insight — expressing geometric quantities (especially tangent-circle radii) in terms of triangle angles/parameters (r,R) and then bounding via analytic inequalities — with mixtilinear-incircle problems closest, then related circumcircle/incircle-tangency constructions, then other triangle-inequality problems, and finally unrelated domains.

Ranked by shared eureka insight: a nonlinear function applied to a mixture/convex combination in an extreme limit is dominated by one extreme component (largest σ_i governs Φ⁻¹ asymptotics via Laplace-principle / tail-domination reasoning).

Ranked by structural affinity to the core reasoning pattern (interchanging double sums and exploiting binomial/combinatorial identities to reduce a series to closed form), prioritizing candidates involving series manipulation with binomial coefficients, termwise operations on sums, and combinatorial-sum telescoping over surface lexical similarity.

Ranked by latent Plancherel/L²-isometry insight: explicit Plancherel use (F13.III.6) and operator-theoretic L² structure (F24.6) top, then integral-transform asymptotics (10563, S14.III.3), with unrelated combinatorics/geometry/ode at bottom.

Ranked by the latent 'aha' of evaluating a nontrivial integral/series to yield zeta values or special constants via analytic regularization, contour integration, or generating-function manipulation, with decreasing structural similarity to the query's tanh-contour-to-zeta pattern.

Ranked by latent reasoning affinity to Riemann Mapping + Schwarz Lemma composition trick: top candidates involve comparing holomorphic maps at a shared point, preserving injectivity/boundedness under limits, or proving existence of a structure-preserving transformation.

Ranked by proximity to the core 'aha' of reducing a differential problem to an algebraic eigenstructure/characteristic equation whose root multiplicities dictate solution form, prioritizing problems that require recognizing a hidden algebraic reduction (inverse eigenvalue, functional-to-ODE, fundamental matrix, Wronskian structure, separation of variables) over surface ODE overlap or unrelated domains.

outputs.headline: Model collapses on oblique math retrieval — 10 of 12 queries recover zero golds and mean nDCG sits at 0.125, far below the pass threshold.
